raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #40094

This adds a budget check to automatically disable the prefill CUDA graph when the available memory is lower than the estimated transient memory required for dequantizing the KV cache. This prevents stalls and out of memory issues on memory constrained GPUs.

Thanks @debanshd. Closing this because you have 12 PRs open and none updated in 7 days, over our soft cap of 5 for idle PRs.

Reopen the two or three you most want reviewed - a short active set moves faster than a long idle one.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),
`bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.

Thanks @debanshd. Closing this because you have 12 PRs open and none updated in 7 days, over our soft cap of 5 for idle PRs.

Reopen the two or three you most want reviewed - a short active set moves faster than a long idle one.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),
`bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.
